plays.desc_ko: 게임 시작 직후 Saint(트리스타나)가 앞으로 나서며 Chovy를 확인하고 교환을 시도. 해설은 정글러와의 교환에서 정글러는 캠프로 회복하지만 미드라이너는 손해를 느낀다고 설명(뒤 구간 일부 마스킹).
plays.desc_en: Right after the game starts, Saint (Tristana) steps forward to check Chovy and look for a trade. The casters note that in trades with a jungler, the jungler can heal back on camps while the mid laner feels the loss.
plays.quote: Powerful Saint ... continues to step forward, spotting out ... Problem is, when you're trading with the

plays.desc_ko: 봇 라인에서 Berserker가 GEN 바텀 듀오 앞으로 공격적으로 나서 푸시/주도권을 확보하려 함. 이미 탈진(exhaust)과 방어막(barrier) 소환사 주문이 교환됨.
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Lucian) steps up aggressively against GEN's bot duo to secure push and priority, with Exhaust and Barrier already traded.
plays.quote: And an exhaust already traded for a ... barrier. How is it that Berserker is not ... afraid to get up in the face of the

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 미드에서 트리스타나 폭발 화약으로 웨이브를 밀고 Galio(Chovy)를 견제하며 체력과 마나를 소모시키고 CS를 놓치게 하려 함.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Tristana) shoves the mid wave with Explosive Charge and harasses Chovy (Galio), aiming to drain his health and mana and make him miss CS.
plays.quote: same story for Saint in the mid-lane. ... No, doing pretty well for himself here. ... keep looking for these angles to harass

plays.desc_ko: Inspired(마오카이, 자막상 'Spire')가 두 번째 칼날부리 리젠을 기다리려다 GEN의 교차 이동(노틸러스+제이스 경합)을 보고 귀환. 크루그 타이밍에 맞춰 복귀하며 시간 손실 없음. 결국 플레이를 시도하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Inspired (Maokai) considers waiting for the second Raptor respawn but recalls after spotting GEN's crossmap move with Nautilus and Jayce, returning in time for Krugs with no tempo lost and never forcing a play.
plays.quote: And Spire was thinking about waiting ... for the recall because they do see the ... going to contest, so Spire just recalls,

plays.desc_ko: 노틸러스(Duro)와 제이스(Canyon)가 교차해 Inspired의 칼날부리 쪽을 경합하러 이동, Duro는 잠재적 플레이를 커버하러 올라감. 상대가 귀환해 경합은 성사되지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Duro (Nautilus) and Canyon (Jayce) cross over to contest Inspired's Raptors, with Duro moving up to cover a potential play, but the contest never happens as the opponent recalls.
plays.quote: cross back and Nautilus plus Jayce both ... going to contest ... And you did see Doran move up to cover

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 Kiin(카밀)이 Dhokla(자막상 'Doinb')와 교환하며 대등하게 유지, Inspired가 탑 쪽에 보이자 뒤로 물러남.
plays.desc_en: Kiin (Camille) trades evenly with Dhokla (K'Sante) in top lane, then backs off once Inspired shows up nearby.
plays.quote: So, Keen backing away, ... but still going even in these trades ... against Doinb.

plays.desc_ko: Galio(Chovy)의 정의의 주먹(E)이 미니언을 완전히 정리하지 못해 효과가 없었고, Chovy가 CS 3개를 잃음.
plays.desc_en: Chovy (Galio)'s Justice Punch fails to fully clear the minions, costing him three CS.
plays.quote: Justice Punch doesn't quite ... quite clear the minion, so ... Doesn't have any effect.

plays.desc_ko: Duro(노틸러스)의 갈고리가 적중했으나 밀리오(Isles)가 즉각 반응해 '울트라 메가 파이어 킥'으로 밀쳐냄.
plays.desc_en: Duro (Nautilus) lands a Dredge Line, but Isles (Milio) reacts instantly and knocks him away with Ultra Mega Fire Kick.
plays.quote: Oh, but the hook landing. ... ultra mega fire kick. ... it on reaction.

plays.desc_ko: Canyon(제이스)이 선제공격 충격 폭발로 견제를 다시 맞힘('Got another one'), 체력바를 깎음.
plays.desc_en: Canyon (Jayce) lands another Shock Blast poke, chipping down health bars.
plays.quote: Canyon's back for some more first strike ... shock blasts. ... Got another one.

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 중립 오브젝트를 시작해 획득. Canyon은 파밍에 전념해 경합하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Inspired (Maokai) starts and takes a neutral objective while Canyon focuses on farming and doesn't contest.
plays.quote: We already have Inspired starting the ... objective here. Canyon clearly committed ... Inspired grabbing this.

plays.desc_ko: 미드 교환: Saint가 Galio 도발이 들어올 것을 알고 할 수 있는 것이 없어 계속 평타를 넣음. 해설은 '그에게 이상적인 교환'이라 평가(앞 구간 마스킹).
plays.desc_en: In a mid trade, Saint (Tristana) knows the Galio taunt is coming and can't avoid it, so he keeps auto-attacking. The casters call it an ideal trade for him.
plays.quote: Kind of the ideal trade for him. ... Saint recognizing he can't do anything ... the taunt is going to connect.

plays.desc_ko: Canyon(제이스)이 뒤쪽에서 봇으로 갱킹, Duro 갈고리 적중. Berserker가 Canyon을 보고 점멸로 뒤로 빠졌지만 Canyon의 큰 피해와 후속으로 퍼스트 블러드(GEN). 리플레이: 대시했지만 갈고리가 이미 적중, 충격 폭발+해머 폼 피해. 이후 Isles 반격으로 Ruler도 쓰러져 원포원.
plays.desc_en: Canyon (Jayce) ganks bot from behind and Duro (Nautilus) lands Dredge Line; Berserker (Lucian) flashes back but Canyon's Shock Blast and Hammer form damage secure First Blood for GEN. Isles' counterattack then brings down Ruler (Ezreal), making it a one-for-one.
plays.quote: It's a Jace coming in from behind. ... Hook goes in. ... Berserker recognizing that Canyon is on

plays.desc_ko: Isles(밀리오)가 몸으로 막으려다 Ruler가 점멸로 들어오자 점멸 킥으로 Ruler를 밀어 처치에 기여, 원포원으로 만듦('Isles sec'). 리플레이에서 같은 장면 재설명.
plays.desc_en: As Ruler (Ezreal) flashes in, Isles (Milio) uses a Flash kick to push him back and help secure the kill, evening it at one-for-one.
plays.quote: KICK BACK FROM ... ISLES TO TAKE DOWN RULER AND TURN IT ... INTO A ONE FOR ONE.

plays.desc_ko: 루시안·밀리오(봇 듀오)가 라인 주도권을 바탕으로 회전해 중립 오브젝트를 확보, LYON이 중립 오브젝트 2개를 보유.
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Lucian) and Isles (Milio) use lane priority to rotate and secure a neutral objective, giving LYON two of them.
plays.quote: Rotating Lucian Milio over. They secure ... their grabs. ... neutral objectives.

plays.desc_ko: Berserker가 웨이브를 하나 더 밀어 넣어 Ruler가 귀환을 취소하고 라인에 남게 됨(대포 미니언 없는 웨이브).
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Lucian) pushes in one more wave, forcing Ruler to cancel his recall and stay in lane for a wave without a cannon minion.
plays.quote: And actually going to go for Okay, Ruler ... cancels his recall and Berserker's going ... to be able to push another one in.

plays.desc_ko: Duro 갈고리 후 Canyon(제이스)이 피해를 이어 대상을 '원탭'. 리플레이: 또 한 번 좋은 Duro 갈고리, 대상은 이전 'Isles sec' 때 점멸을 써서 없었음.
plays.desc_en: After another strong Dredge Line from Duro (Nautilus), Canyon (Jayce) follows up to one-tap the target, who had no Flash after using it in the earlier Isles play.
plays.quote: Okay, and Jayce is there to follow up ... Canyon just one-taps him. ... another great hook here from Duro.

plays.desc_ko: Duro가 Isles를 갈고리로 잡았지만 LYON 팀('the cats')이 도착해 Isles가 생존. Duro가 몸으로 막고 Canyon은 뒤에 있음. Canyon은 가속 관문으로 후퇴하며 충격 폭발을 쏨. GEN은 사거리 우위에도 교전을 이어가지 못함.
plays.desc_en: Duro (Nautilus) hooks Isles (Milio), but LYON arrives and Isles survives. Canyon (Jayce) retreats through Acceleration Gate firing Shock Blast, and GEN can't continue the fight despite their range advantage.
plays.quote: DURO CAUGHT HIM, BUT THE CATS HAVE ... ARRIVED AND ISLES IS STILL LIVING. ... body blocking, Canyon still standing

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 Duro에게 합류해 앞라인으로 Duro에게 피해를 주고 GEN을 후퇴시킴. 해설은 'Isles 미끼'로 규정.
plays.desc_en: LYON collapses onto Duro (Nautilus), damaging him with their frontline and forcing GEN back. The casters call it Isles bait.
plays.quote: BUT THE CATS HAVE ... bit of damage onto Duro. ... gate goes for the retreat, a shock blast

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 드래곤을 시작하고 체력을 깎았으나 마지막 강타 싸움에서 Inspired가 패배해 두 번째 드래곤을 놓침.
plays.desc_en: LYON starts dragon and chunks it, but Inspired (Maokai) loses the final Smite fight and misses the second dragon.
plays.quote: going to start up the dragon here ... getting lower. ... Inspired losing the smite mini game, but

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 체력이 1 남은 상황에서 Canyon이 강타로 드래곤을 획득(리플레이 설명).
plays.desc_en: With the dragon at 1 HP, Canyon (Jayce) Smites it to secure the objective.
plays.quote: AGAIN, ONE HEALTH AGAIN, MAN. ... CANYON GETS IT ... Inspired losing the smite mini game

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 앞 교전: Canyon 견제 후 Kiin이 Berserker를 거의 한 번에 잡을 뻔하고 Chovy의 궁극기(공) 진입, LYON의 보호로 시간을 벌었지만 결국 Chovy가 Berserker를 처치. 그러나 GEN이 과하게 들어가 역으로 피해를 봄('bit off more than they could chew').
plays.desc_en: After Canyon's poke, Kiin (Camille) nearly one-shots Berserker (Lucian) and Chovy (Galio) dives in with his ultimate; LYON's peel buys time, but Chovy finishes Berserker. GEN, however, bites off more than they can chew.
plays.quote: Canyon fishing for a bit of poke. ... get one-tapped by Keen. Ball is THERE ... moment, BUT IT'S CHOVY WHO GRABS THE

plays.desc_ko: LYON의 역공: Berserker 보호로 시간을 버는 동안 Dhokla가 Kiin을 압박해 처치, Saint가 Canyon의 체력을 찢어 처치, 이어 Ruler를 추격해 처치. Chovy는 간신히 탈출. 해설은 LYON이 교전을 이겼다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: While Berserker is protected, Dhokla (K'Sante) pressures and kills Kiin, Saint (Tristana) shreds Canyon, then chases down Ruler as Chovy barely escapes. The casters say LYON won the fight.
plays.quote: EYES ON SAINT, THE LAST REMAINING ... AD CARRY AS HE SHREDS through Canyon's ... RULER IN TROUBLE.

plays.desc_ko: Canyon이 탑의 Dhokla(자막 'Doku')를 방문, 세 명이 투입됐으나 상대가 K'Sante라 귀환을 선택. 귀환이 끊길 것 같다는 언급 후 결과 불명.
plays.desc_en: Canyon (Jayce) visits Dhokla (K'Sante) top with three players committed, but facing K'Sante, GEN opts to recall. The recall may get interrupted, but the outcome is unclear.
plays.quote: Here comes Canyon now up to visit ... Doku. ... Three members committed, and it's a

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 포탑 방패를 연이어 획득하고 로켓 점프로 Chovy를 피해 빠짐. Chovy는 포탑을 지키려 하지만 해설은 포탑이 무너질 것이라 말함.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Tristana) takes plate after plate and escapes Chovy with Rocket Jump. Chovy tries to defend, but the casters say the tower will fall.
plays.quote: Quick rocket jump out. Saint, of course, ... I believe it as he gets another turret ... nice quick rocket jump out.

plays.desc_ko: 전령 20초 전 Inspired가 탑 쪽을 맴돌고, LYON이 오브젝트를 향해 진입.
plays.desc_en: With 20 seconds until Herald, Inspired (Maokai) lingers top side and LYON moves in toward the objective.
plays.quote: see Inspired hovering around the top ... A nice start ... for the side of Lion as they move in for

plays.desc_ko: Galio(Chovy)가 합류해 GEN이 싸움을 걸음. Kiin 압박에 Berserker와 Saint가 점멸로 후퇴. GEN은 제이스+이즈리얼 견제로 큰 피해와 소환사 주문을 빼내고 과하게 들어가지 않고 LYON을 밀어냄.
plays.desc_en: Chovy (Galio) joins and GEN picks a fight; Kiin's pressure forces Berserker and Saint to Flash away. Jayce and Ezreal poke deals heavy damage and burns summoners, pushing LYON off without overcommitting.
plays.quote: Here comes the Galio though. ... They're going to fight it. ... be forced to flash here

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 마오카이 궁극기와 Berserker의 대시로 진입을 시도했으나 아무도 맞지 않아 공간만 벌고, 궁극기 이후 후퇴('Path maker to retreat'). 해설은 느린 마오카이 궁극기를 문제로 지적.
plays.desc_en: LYON tries to engage with Maokai's ultimate and Berserker's dash but hits no one, only gaining space before retreating. The casters point to the slow Nature's Grasp as the problem.
plays.quote: If dash in from Berserker? ... It buys space, but nobody gets hit, so ... Path maker to retreat

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤이 있는 상태에서 GEN이 일찍 자리 잡고 걸어감, Canyon이 또 충격 폭발로 견제를 노림.
plays.desc_en: With dragon up, GEN sets up early and walks in, as Canyon (Jayce) looks for another Shock Blast poke.
plays.quote: fog of war. They're walking over now. ... Canyon fishing for another shock.

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 마오카이 묘목으로 부쉬를 채워 시야/부쉬 장악.
plays.desc_en: Inspired (Maokai) fills the brushes with Sapling Toss to control vision.
plays.quote: Of course the Malachi does have saplings ... and Spire's trying to keep these brush ... The brush has been populated.

plays.desc_ko: 준비가 끝나고 Inspired가 오브젝트(드래곤 추정)를 마무리하려 함. 이후 구간 마스킹으로 결과 불명.
plays.desc_en: With setup complete, Inspired (Maokai) tries to finish the objective, likely the dragon; the result is unclear.
plays.quote: Now the setup is there, inspired, hoping ... to finish off this one.

plays.desc_ko: 봇 쪽에 GEN이 인원을 모으고 Kiin이 진입. Isles가 커버하고 Saint가 맞교환하자 GEN이 즉시 후퇴.
plays.desc_en: GEN gathers bot side and Kiin (Camille) goes in, but after Isles covers and Saint trades back, GEN immediately retreats.
plays.quote: Bot side though, overloaded from GenG. ... Keane going in. ... Iles is here to cover, so Saint going to

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 다음 교전 전 소환사 주문을 빼려고 견제/낚시. 탈진이 사용되고 LYON이 후퇴, 마오카이 궁극기도 사용됨. 이후 Ruler 견제로 상대 체력을 깎음('only 30% of his HP').
plays.desc_en: GEN fishes with poke to burn summoners before the next fight; Exhaust is used, LYON backs off and Maokai's ultimate is spent. Ruler (Ezreal) then pokes a target down to only 30% HP.
plays.quote: Exhaust ... top side. So, Genji clearly fishing, ... hoping to get through some of those

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 Canyon에게서 대시로 빠지고, Inspired가 마오카이 궁극기(자연의 손아귀)를 이탈용으로 사용.
plays.desc_en: LYON dashes away from Canyon, with Inspired (Maokai) using Nature's Grasp to disengage.
plays.quote: Exhaust down. Now trying to retreat. ... Dash away from Canyon. That's the all T ... from Inspired used to disengage.

plays.desc_ko: 그 사이 LYON이 탑 쪽 포탑을 획득.
plays.desc_en: Meanwhile, LYON takes a top side tower.
plays.quote: Lion will at least grab a tower on the ... top side.

plays.desc_ko: GEN의 미드 푸시 압박에 Berserker가 앞으로 나와 최대한 웨이브를 정리. 해설은 드래곤 타이밍과 맞지 않는다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Facing GEN's mid push, Berserker (Lucian) steps up to clear the wave as much as possible. The casters say it doesn't line up with dragon timing.
plays.quote: The Zerkers going to step up and clear ... Uh just some mid lane push, just a bit ... of pressure there.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 팀 콜에 따라 바텀 바위게를 획득(Chovy의 대기 포함).
plays.desc_en: Following the team call, GEN takes bot Scuttle Crab, with Chovy waiting nearby.
plays.quote: Genji though happy to get this crab. ... They get the bottom scuttle crab.

plays.desc_ko: LYON(쌍원딜 팀)이 바론 쪽으로 이동했으나 해설은 바론 시도가 아닌 대치(posturing)로 판단.
plays.desc_en: LYON, with their double marksman comp, moves toward Baron, but the casters read it as posturing rather than a Baron attempt.
plays.quote: They're all running towards that Baron ... They do have double AD ... So it is just uh posturing.

plays.desc_ko: GEN이 미드에서 견제로 라인 주도권 싸움을 하며 미드 포탑을 부수려 하고, LYON은 접근을 막음. Saint가 강 쪽으로 이동해 합류.
plays.desc_en: GEN fights for mid priority with poke to take the mid tower while LYON blocks access, and Saint moves to the river to join.
plays.quote: They're taking a bit of poke damage ... here. It's a battle over mid lane ... Genji painfully aware hoping to break

plays.desc_ko: Chovy가 탑 사이드 웨이브를 밀어 넣고, Dhokla(자막 'Doubla')가 이를 보고 받으러 감. Chovy와 Dhokla의 1대1 구도, LYON은 Chovy의 TP/귀환을 주시.
plays.desc_en: Chovy (Galio) shoves the top side wave and Dhokla (K'Sante) goes to catch it, setting up a one-on-one while LYON watches Chovy's TP and recall.
plays.quote: Chovi's going to go push top side right ... now. Okay, so Genji's going to get that ... wave in. Oh, Doubla. Okay, Doubla does

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 밀려나고 GEN이 드래곤 접근로의 부쉬 두 곳을 장악. Inspired는 묘목을 던져 넣으려 함.
plays.desc_en: LYON gets pushed back and GEN takes the two brushes on the dragon approach, while Inspired tries to toss saplings in.
plays.quote: Yeah, and now Lion are already pushed ... out. So Genji have taken control. ... Good job. They get control of both

plays.desc_ko: Berserker가 진입해 LYON 주도로 교전을 열려 했으나 노틸러스와 정면으로 마주치고, Ruler는 점멸로 빠짐. Inspired의 궁극기 후속이 좋았지만 GEN이 이미 성공적으로 빠짐.
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Lucian) dives in to start a fight but runs face-first into Nautilus as Ruler flashes away. Inspired's ultimate follow-up is good, but GEN has already escaped.
plays.quote: Berserker in. ... Lion now trying to start ... a fight on their terms. Berserker caught

plays.desc_ko: Kiin이 바위게 시야를 얻고 Saint(체력 50%)를 보자 갈고리-점멸-궁극기+Galio로 진입. Saint는 버스터 샷과 로켓 점프로 간신히 생존. GEN은 Inspired를 추격해 Chovy가 마무리.
plays.desc_en: Spotting Saint at 50% HP via Scuttle vision, Kiin (Camille) engages with Hookshot, Flash and Hextech Ultimatum alongside Galio. Saint barely survives with Buster Shot and Rocket Jump, and GEN chases Inspired for Chovy to finish.
plays.quote: Keen does get the scuttle crab vision. ... Flash in onto Saint. Saint with the ... MANAGES TO SURVIVE.

plays.desc_ko: Berserker가 Ruler를 노렸지만 갈고리는 피했어도 탈진을 맞아 아무것도 못함. Dhokla가 버티는 사이 Saint가 재진입해 Chovy에게 첫 리셋(처치). 결과적으로 GEN 2킬, LYON 1킬.
plays.desc_en: Berserker (Lucian) goes for Ruler and dodges the hook but is neutered by Exhaust. With Dhokla holding the line, Saint (Tristana) re-enters for his first reset on Chovy, leaving GEN with two kills to LYON's one.
plays.quote: BERSERKER versus Ruler. EXHAUST NOW ... as Saint RE-ENTERS THE FIGHT. WILL FIND ... THE FIRST RESET ONTO CHOVY, BUT IT'S

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 GEN이 드래곤 획득.
